title: Alkule latin potndinaaɗe: no Pular winndirtee e laawol gootol
introduction: Binndol latin potndinaangol wallitii ngam moƴƴinde janngugol e winndugol Pular e Fulfulde. Anndu no ɗee alkule ngari e hol ko woni kuule mum ngam yimɓe Fuuṭa Jaloo fof paama, gila e dow haa e les.

body.value: Pular, hono Fulfulde, ko ɗemngal kaaleteengal e leyɗeele keewɗe e Afrik. E nder Fuuṭa Jaloo, ɗemngal ngal ina inndiree Pular, tawi e nokkuuji goɗɗi ina wiyee Fulfulde. Kono, ko adii potndingol binndol mum, laawol winndirde ɗemngal ngal ina seertatno fawaade e nokku oo e neɗɗo winndooɗo oo.

Ngam wallude janngugol e winndugol, annduɓe ɗemɗe e fedde UNESCO ƴeewtii no alkule latin mbaawirta huutoreede e ɗemɗe Afrik. Batu Bamako e hitaande 1966, e batu Niamey e hitaande 1978, ngoni daawe ɗiɗi mawɗe e ngal gollal.

Ko adii yaynaade binndol latin, Fulɓe e yimɓe Fuuṭa Jaloo ina kuutortoo Ajami — binndol moƴƴinaangol e alkule aarabeeɓe — ngam winndude ɗemngal maɓɓe. Ajami ina jogii nokku mawɗo e taariika binndol Pular e Fulfulde. Hay so binndol latin huutortee hannde ngam jaŋde e binndi kese, Ajami ina heddii e kuutoragol ngam diine, ɓataakeeji, e defte taariika.
E jamanu koloñaal, laabi binndol latin ɗi huutortenoo ɗii ina ceertunoo e leyɗeele ɗee. Ɗum waɗi janngooɓe e winndooɓe ɓee mbaawaano janngude ɗemngal ngal e laawol gootol.
Bamako e Niamey: daawe ɗiɗi e potndingol

• Batu Bamako (1966) : UNESCO yuɓɓini batu annduɓe ɗemɗe to Bamako, e Mali. Faandaare batu ngol ko moƴƴinde binndol ɗemɗe Afrik Hirnaange e potndinde alkule mum en. Pular/Fulfulde ina wonnoo e hakkunde ɗemɗe ɗe annduɓe ɓee ƴeewtii.
  • Batu Niamey (1978) : Batu goɗɗo waɗii to Niamey, e Niiseer. Annduɓe ɓee ƴeewtii kuule e caɗeele binndol ɗemɗe Afrik, ɓe mbaɗi Alkule Afrik Tuugnorgal (Alphabet africain de référence). Ɗum hokki annduɓe, pelle, e laamuuji cuɓal ngam ƴeewtaade e yuɓɓinde binndol ɗemɗe mum en.
Potndingol ngol wallitii waɗde kuule binndol laaɓtuɗe, hay so tawii no winndirtee ina waawi seertude seeɗa hakkunde leyɗeele e calɗi ɗemngal ngal.
E binndol latin Pular, alkule ina kuutoree ngam hollirde sawtooji ɗemngal ngal no haanirta. Alkule goɗɗe ina nanndi e ɗe Farayse, tee goɗɗe ina njogii sawto keeriiɗo.

Pular ina huutoroo alkule laaɓɗe joy: a, e, i, o, u. E binndol Pular, ɗe mbinndetaake e maale dow mum hono é, è walla à e Farayse. So sawto alkulal laaɓngal juutii, alkulal ngal ina sowee : aa, ee, ii, oo, uu.

• Alkule keeriiɗe : E nder Pular ina woodi ɓ, ɗ, ƴ e ŋ, ɗe ngollata ngam hollirde sawtooji ɗemngal ngal (yeru: ɓiɗɗo, ɗemngal, ƴiiƴam, ŋari).
  • Alkule kawraaɗe : Ina woodi kadi alkule kawraaɗe hono mb, nd, ng e nj (yeru: mbeewa, ndiyam, ngalu, njaayri).
  • Sawto palatal nasal : Winndugol ngol sawto ina waawi yiyde ñ, ɲ walla ny, fawaade e laawol binndol kuutorgol ngol.
  • Alkule c e j : Ɗee alkule ina njogii sawto mum en e Pular ; winndugol ɗe ina seerti e binndol Farayse tch e dj (yeru: ceedu, jaango).

Potndingol alkule wallata janngooɓe e winndooɓe heɓde laabi ɗi ɓe mbaawi rewde. Hono noon kadi, ɗum ina walla waɗde defte, janngirɗe, e kabaruuji e Pular ngam yimɓe Fuuṭa Jaloo fof paama, gila e dow haa e les.

Taariika binndol ngal ina hollita gollal annduɓe e pelle keewɗe ngam waɗde ɗemngal ngal ɓeydaade winndireede e janngireede. Ajami e binndol latin potndinaangol, kala gooto e mum en, ina jogii nokku mum e taariika e nguurndam Pular.
